annotations.title: Redact personal data from a PDF

description: Finds IDs, bank accounts, cards, phone numbers, emails, names and addresses and really redacts them: nothing is left under the black box. Returns a link to download the result (kept about an hour). Credits on paid plans: 3 per page.

categories.description: What to redact Values: 'dni' = Spanish ID (DNI, NIE); 'iban' = Bank accounts (IBAN); 'tarjeta' = Cards; 'telefono' = Phone numbers; 'email' = Emails; 'nombre' = Names; 'direccion' = Addresses

files.description: Input files (.pdf). Each one is a public http(s) URL, or an object with `url`, or with `name` and `content_base64` (small files only: up to 20 MB in total).

anyOf.description: public http(s) URL of the file

name.description: file name with its extension, e.g. report.pdf

url.description: public http(s) URL of the file

lang.description: Language. Language of the texts the tool adds. Values: 'es' = Spanish; 'en' = English

mode.description: Result Values: 'tachar' = Redact them (permanent); 'marcar' = Just mark them, to review

terms.description: Other words or names, separated by commas. e.g. Ana Ruiz, Project Phoenix

name: redact_pdf
title: Redact personal data from a PDF
